definitions.explanation: A small medical facility, typically run by a single doctor or small group.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}くの{医院|いいん}に{行|い}きました。
examples.english: I went to a nearby clinic.

examples.japanese: {内科|ないか}{医院|いいん}で{診|み}てもらった。
examples.english: I was examined at an internal medicine clinic.

examples.japanese: {歯科|しか}{医院|いいん}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I made an appointment at the dental clinic.

notes:
{医院|いいん} refers to a small clinic or doctor's office.

COMMON TYPES:
- {内科|ないか}{医院|いいん} (internal medicine clinic)
- {歯科|しか}{医院|いいん} (dental clinic)
- {眼科|がんか}{医院|いいん} (eye clinic)
- {皮膚科|ひふか}{医院|いいん} (dermatology clinic)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {医院|いいん}: clinic (small, private)
- {病院|びょういん}: hospital (larger facility)
- クリニック: clinic (loanword)
